items.title: Norman Foster says nuclear is key for 'Electrical Revolution'
items.summary: Architect Norman Foster says that nuclear's ability to provide a "vast amount of power" with "a tiny imprint" means that micro-modular power units should be being produced at "industrial-scale, like jet engines" with the potential to autonomously power new developments and move beyond the "obsolete idea of a grid".

items.title: Bannerman completes Etango funding, moves towards FID
items.summary: Bannerman Energy has completed an AUD124 million (USD89 million) underwritten placement which - together with the company's other financial arrangements - is expected to fully fund the Namibian Etango project through construction and ramp-up as the company moves towards a Final Investment Decision.

items.title: Westinghouse fuel approved for Czech Temelín units
items.summary: The Czech Republic's State Office for Nuclear Security has given the go-ahead for Westinghouse's fuel to be used at ČEZ's VVER-1000 units at Temelín Nuclear Power Plant.

items.title: Google signs up for electricity from Finnish nuclear power plant
items.summary: Tech giant Google has signed a long-term power purchase agreement with Finland's Fortum covering up to 50% of the Loviisa nuclear power plant's capacity and providing financial certainty for power uprates and lifetime extensions until 2050.

items.title: Summit hears of surging interest in investing in nuclear projects
items.summary: The growing interest in investing in nuclear energy, and how to ensure projects are structured to attract it, were key themes at the World Nuclear Symposium Finance Summit , which was also told that financiers feel like they are missing out if they haven't done nuclear deals.

items.title: Centrus to supply Radiant with microreactor fuel
items.summary: US enrichment company Centrus Energy and California-based nuclear microreactor developer Radiant have signed a definitive multi-year contract to supply high-assay, low-enriched uranium fuel needed to deploy multiple Kaleidos microreactors.

items.title: Groundwork begins at new Chinese plant site
items.summary: Full-scale site levelling work for the initial phase of the Laiyang nuclear power plant in China's Shandong Province has begun, State Power Investment Corporation announced. The site will eventually house six Guohe One (CAP1400) units.

items.title: US Department of Energy closes loan for Duane Arnold restart
items.summary: The US Department of Energy's Office of Energy Dominance Financing has closed a loan of up to USD1.9 billion to NextEra Energy to help finance the restart of the Duane Arnold Energy Center, taking the company closer to bringing Iowa's only nuclear power plant back into operation.

items.summary: ABB has signed a memorandum of understanding with the UK's Rolls-Royce SMR through which ABB will explore how its automation and electrification solutions can be used in the delivery of company's standardised, factory-built small modular reactors.

items.summary: Cold functional tests have been completed at unit 4 of the Changjiang nuclear power plant in China's Hainan province, China National Nuclear Corporation has announced.

items.title: Zaporizhzhia reconnected to external power after 18 days
items.summary: A local ceasefire brokered by the International Atomic Energy Agency has allowed work to successfully take place to restore off-site power to the Zaporizhzhia nuclear power plant.

items.title: US maritime nuclear energy company raises USD50 million
items.summary: Bluecore Energy, a developer of small modular, water-cooled reactors designed to operate aboard floating barges, has announced the close of a USD50 million seed financing to accelerate development, testing, and deployment of its floating nuclear energy systems.
